findings.title: ESP control pins left floating
findings.why: The ESP enable and IO0 pins are only connected to header pins with no driver or pull‑up/down, leading to undefined logic levels.

findings.title: Ultrasonic sensor pins lack bias resistors
findings.why: The ECHO and TRIG lines are connected directly to the MCU without pull‑up/down, which can cause spurious signals.

findings.title: Diode orientation may be reversed
findings.why: Both Schottky diodes are placed with their anodes on the power nets, which is opposite the typical reverse‑polarity protection configuration.

findings.title: Trace width on +3.3 V net may be undersized
findings.why: The narrowest trace is 0.30 mm, below the 0.5 mm per amp guideline for the expected current, risking voltage drop.

findings.title: BOOT0 pin has no defined default state

findings.title: Feedback resistor value 56 k2 is non‑standard

findings.title: Inductor part SPM3015T‑3R3M may be unavailable or ambiguous
findings.why: The part number is not a widely stocked standard inductor series, which could cause procurement delays.

findings.title: HC‑SR04 header pin order does not match typical sensor pinout
findings.why: The board routes VCC, Echo, Trig, GND while many breakout boards expect VCC, Trig, Echo, GND, risking mis‑wiring by users.
